description_en: Queries the authorized APIs of a specified APP
description_zh: 查询指定 APP 已授权的API列表，即指定 APP 的API列表
name: DescribeAuthorizedApis

parameters.help_en: The application ID, which is generated by the system and globally unique
parameters.help_zh: App编号，系统生成，全局唯一
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的页码，默认是1，起始是1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时每页行数，最大值100，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size
